target: acceptance 6 — trailing content is refused as an invalid value (exit 2), and the message echoes the whole offending string so the author sees what they wrote.
cmd: e=$("$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/lib/tracker.sh" profile "$FIXTURES/profile/trailing.md" 2>&1 >/dev/null); c=$?; n=$(printf "%s" "$e" | grep -c "per security review"); printf '{"c":%s,"echoesOffender":%s}' "$c" "$n"
